Hahaha! What’s that?
You say the elevator doesn’t work?\c
Course not! I’ve been keeping the Lift Key safe
this whole time!
Gah! Now how am I supposed to keep you from\ntaking the Lift Key?!\c\nGuess I’ll have to use my own kind of Struggle!
I hope my bosses don’t hear about this!

Hah...hah... Phew!\c
Without that key, there’s no way you’ll make it
to the boss!\c
If you think you can get it back from up there,
then I’d sure like to see you try! Haha!
There’s no way you’re getting that Lift Key now!\c\nNot unless you know some way to walk on top\nof the walls or something. ...Like that’d happen!
That Pokémon of yours looks pretty nimble,\nI gotta say...
You got the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Lift Key[VAR COLOR(0000)]!
